violation_type.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
violation_type.short_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

finding_variants.text: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.
A bottle of cleaning chemicals was observed sitting on top of a toilet in the preschool restroom.

During the inspection, a can of Lysol was observed to be within reach of children in care. This was corrected during the inspection when staff removed the Lysol and placed it in an area inaccessible to children.

This standard was reviewed in relation to the investigation and found to be deficient. The caregiver was observed on camera cleaning a table that had food directly on it that a child was observed eating with a cleaning agent.

I observed Clorox wipes accessible to children in the pre-school classroom and on the diaper changing table in the infant room.     This was corrected when the wipes were moved to a location inaccessible to children.
Doorknob covers were installed to prevent children from opening the janitorial room door, keeping cleaning supplies out of their reach.
